newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mingly hit record high after flats sale.
newsitem.headline: Mingly hit record high after flats sale.

text.p: Shares of Mingly Corp Ltd surged to an all time high of HK$2.10 before slipping back to $2.05, a gain of 4.59 percent, in early trade following strong demand for flats developed in a joint venture by one of its subsidiaries, brokers said on Wednesday.
"The strong flats sale response plus a big trading discount to the net asset value fueled demand," said Michael Ng from Sassoon Securities.
Analysts said the stock was trading at a discount of about 50 percent to its net asset value of HK$4.80 to HK$5.00 per share. The shares jumped HK$0.13 or 7.10 percent on Tuesday to close at $1.96.
Volume was 6.16 million shares worth HK$12.65 million.

Pre-sale demand for flats at Discovery Park in the New Territories, a joint venture development between New World Development Co Ltd and Mingly's subsidiary HKR International Ltd, was 106 times oversubscribed.
Shares of New World were down HK$0.40 to HK$39.50 in early trade, while HKR was unchanged at HK$10.00 per share.
